recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white landscape photograph featuring a vast desert plain with a central dark hill, framed by a thick white border. The sky is filled with textured, dramatic clouds, and the foreground shows motion blur, suggesting a view from a moving vehicle. Minimalist sans-serif text is centered in the upper third of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark silhouette of the hill anchors the horizontal expanse of the desert.
The wide white border creates a gallery-like framing effect for the grainy image.
The centered typography provides a stable focal point against the dynamic motion blur of the foreground.
The contrast between the bright sky and the dark scrubland creates a balanced tonal weight.
coreInvariants: Extreme horizontal landscape orientation within a square frame
Visible film grain and motion blur

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The horizon line sits at the vertical center, with a small dark hill acting as the primary subject at the midpoint.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central dark hill and the centered text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the sharp text at the top, down to the dark hill, and then follows the horizontal motion blur across the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the expansive sky and the thick white outer border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the sky and desert floor.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the central hill and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the border and bright cloud highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the dark land and bright sky.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Periods used as separators with equal spacing to letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying tracking to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and clean lines.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and uniform stroke.
Offers a modern, clean look that works well with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black and white wide-angle photograph of a desert landscape. Include a small dark hill in the center distance. The foreground should have horizontal motion blur as if taken from a moving car. The sky should be filled with dramatic, textured clouds. Frame the entire image with a thick, solid white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the upper third of the image. Use solid black for the text color and apply extremely wide tracking between all characters, including punctuation.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is there a thick white border around the photograph?
Is the text centered with very wide tracking?
Does the foreground show horizontal motion blur?

adjustableVariables: Amount of motion blur in the foreground
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
Unique photographic artifacts that identify a specific location
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the motion blur is strictly horizontal.
Verify the white border is uniform on all four sides.
Confirm the grain texture is consistent across the image area.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, motion-blurred B&W landscape with centered, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif typography, all contained within a thick white gallery frame.
